findings.message: readMeta's return type declares optional properties without `| undefined` ({ createdAt?: string; epicCreatedAt?: string; epicSlug?: string; standalone?: boolean }). The repo convention under exactOptionalPropertyTypes is `prop?: T | undefined`, and sibling code in src/workflow/storage.ts follows it (for example `standalone?: boolean | undefined` in pathsForWorkflow and storyRecordFolderArgs).

spec.ts redefines private `firstSentence` (line 133) and exported `isCitationArray` (line 172), which duplicate the same helpers in src/workflow/artifacts/define.ts (lines 175 and 203). This rests on only two artifact modules, so it is reported as possible drift from a shared-helper idiom, not a confirmed breach.

Promised smoke check (planMigration dry run over this repo listing d9f85b3c's consolidation with no unmappable standalone entries) has no corresponding test in the grounding, and a grep of src/**/*.test.ts finds no reference to d9f85b3c. It may have been a manual dry run, but no build record confirms it ran or what it produced. Present-but-unverified at best; it cannot be confirmed from the evidence available.
findings.expectationRef: planMigration dry run over this repo lists d9f85b3c's consolidation with no unmappable standalone entries

findings.message: `storyOrdinalOf` re-derives a Story ordinal by calling `deriveWorkItemIdentity` with a dummy all-zero hash and an epoch timestamp, then reading `.story`, and returns undefined on any error. It reaches the same `storyIdToOrdinal` parse that `compareStoryOrdinal` (storage.ts:450) calls directly. That gives the codebase a second, roundabout ordinal path, while the recent commits set out to have one story-ordinal rule. If `storyWorkflowId`/`deriveWorkItemIdentity` ever adds validation on the hash or date, this helper will quietly start returning undefined. `nestedShapeKey`/`artifactShapeKey` would then drop markerless BUILD/CR artifacts from the nested index without any error, while `compareStoryOrdinal` keeps working. Call `storyIdToOrdinal` directly, or share one exported ordinal helper.

`isCitationArray` is a byte-for-byte copy of the exported guard in define.ts:203, and both are exported. If the Citation shape changes and only one copy is updated, the two validators will disagree. Import the define.ts guard, or move it to a shared module.
The private `firstSentence` helper is identical to `firstSentence` in define.ts:175 (same regex and same 80/77-char truncation). This is minor duplication. Extract it to a shared render util.
